slides.title: Perplexity
slides.narration: A ninety-second guide to Perplexity, from the AiGovOps Foundation and the NCW AI Camp.

slides.title: What it is
lines: Perplexity is a search-and-answer tool that reads the live web and returns a cited summary instead of a list of blue links.
Every claim links to its source, which makes it ideal for 'keep the receipts' work.
The free tier gives unlimited quick searches; Pro adds deeper research runs, file uploads, and a choice of underlying models.
slides.narration: Perplexity is a search-and-answer tool that reads the live web and returns a cited summary instead of a list of blue links. Every claim links to its source, which makes it ideal for 'keep the receipts' work. There's a free tier to start.

slides.title: What's cool for NCW
lines: Educators: research a current-events topic and hand students the citation list to evaluate source quality
SMB owners: compare three POS systems or scan local regulations with sources you can forward to your accountant
Community leaders: verify a statistic before it goes in a newsletter — and keep the link as your receipt
slides.narration: Here's what's cool for our valley. Educators can research a current-events topic and hand students the citation list to evaluate source quality; SMB owners can compare three POS systems or scan local regulations with sources you can forward to your accountant; Community leaders can verify a statistic before it goes in a newsletter — and keep the link as your receipt.

slides.title: The rules — the AiGovOps way
lines: A human on the trigger — you read it before it goes out
Keep the receipts — save your prompt and the answer
Mind the data cost of “free” — no student records, IEPs, or private details in a free tool
slides.narration: Now the rules, the AiGovOps way. Keep a human on the trigger: you read it before it goes out. Keep the receipts: save your prompt and the answer. And mind the data cost of free — never paste student records, an I-E-P, or a customer's private details into a free tool, because free tools learn from what you type.
